papers.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
papers.abstract: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions. A hypernetwork framework generates repository-specific LoRA adapters, effectively injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead.

papers.title: Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?
papers.abstract: Video generation models are evaluated through robotic manipulation tasks to assess their ability to reflect physical reality. An evaluation framework converts generated videos into robot trajectories and executes them in a physics simulator.

papers.title: The Road Ahead in Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Multimodal Dataset
papers.abstract: A European dataset with high-fidelity sensors and comprehensive 3D HD maps, featuring synchronized global-shutter cameras, long-range lidar beyond 400m, 4D imaging radar, and redundant GNSS/INS localization for autonomous driving research.

papers.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
papers.abstract: A unified framework introduces structured affordance forecasting as an intermediate representation to improve perception-action mapping in robotic manipulation by leveraging pretrained vision-language models.

papers.title: MAOAM: Unified Object and Material Selection with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: A unified vision-language model framework enables precise object and material selection through text or click interactions, supporting diverse image editing workflows with improved robustness.

papers.title: Absorbing Complexity: An Interaction-Native Knowledge Harness for Financial LLM Agents
papers.abstract: An architecture for financial LLM agents that absorbs complexity into the system through structured knowledge management, temporal graph memory, and governance mechanisms for safer decisions.

papers.title: BRepCLIP: Contrastive Multimodal Pretraining on BRep Primitives for CAD Understanding
papers.abstract: The first framework to align boundary representation geometry with language and image embeddings through contrastive pretraining, improving retrieval and classification performance over point-based methods.

papers.title: Regret Minimization with Adaptive Opponents in Repeated Games
papers.abstract: Introduces Repeated Policy Regret as a game-theoretic metric for analyzing adaptive opponents in repeated games, offering stronger equilibrium guarantees through novel non-convex optimization algorithms.

papers.title: LLM Anonymization Against Agentic Re-Identification
papers.abstract: An LLM-powered anonymization framework balances privacy protection against agentic web-search re-identification while preserving contextual utility through adaptive privacy scopes.

papers.title: AURA: Intent-Directed Probing for Implicit-Need Surfacing in Situated LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Enhances query answering by incorporating an intent inference step that estimates implicit needs and optimizes tool usage through gap scoring, improving implicit-need coverage.

cc_updates.body: Added fallbackModel setting to configure up to three fallback models tried in order when the primary model is overloaded or unavailable; --fallback-model now also applies to interactive sessions. Added glob pattern support in deny rule tool-name position; allow rules reject non-MCP globs. Hardened cross-session messaging: messages relayed via SendMessage from other Claude sessions no longer carry user authority. MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0, --thinking disabled, and the per-model thinking toggle now disable thinking on models that think by default via the Claude API. Claude Code now retries a turn once on the fallback model when the API rejects an unexpected non-retryable error. claude update now announces the target version before downloading. Fixed a recurring image could not be processed error and extra token usage when an unprocessable image was sent in a session.
